heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15450636:2802.Oct. 19, 1984, Pub. L. 98–520, § 2, 98 Stat. 2428. The words “and subject to the laws of such State or States” are omitted as unnecessary.
